description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to food and nutrition security of vulnerable smallholder farmers and their communities by strengthening the resilience and inclusiveness of value chains in Myanmar.The specific objective will be to improve the availability and access to safe, nutritious and diversified food for vulnerable producers and consumers in targeted states of Myanmar, and to improve nutrition awareness of all value chains stakeholders.
